claim: The Operational briefing strip renders above the goal tiles for Kentucky and Florida with governed headlines, opens the plan-period accountability record in place, and deep-links into the accountability goal.
assertions: KY: the briefing strip renders above the goal tile grid (strip top 277px, grid top 2078px).

KY: 3 briefing cards render by default and 11 after "Show all"; the first headline is "The routine Title XIX grant is 1% of Kentucky's federal award dollars expiring within a year; the 13 awards worth $243.4M to service providers are where an expiration would reach people."; no headline or lede contains prohibited verdict wording.
KY: the plan-period accountability record opens inside the card with plan, overpayment, and derived columns and 24 non-comparable cells shaded.
KY: the sanction record shows the indexed contract section and PDF page beside the state's own citation.
KY: "Open in Contract Accountability" navigates to that goal page and the strip yields to the goal detail.
FL: the briefing strip renders above the goal tile grid (strip top 277px, grid top 2073px).

FL: 3 briefing cards render by default and 11 after "Show all"; the first headline is "The routine Title XIX grant is 0% of Florida's federal award dollars expiring within a year; the 35 awards worth $1.2B to service providers are where an expiration would reach people."; no headline or lede contains prohibited verdict wording.
FL: the plan-period accountability record opens inside the card with plan, overpayment, and derived columns and 40 non-comparable cells shaded.
FL: "Open in Strengthen Plan Accountability" navigates to that goal page and the strip yields to the goal detail.
